selection_rule: First cutoff with >=100 exact query rows, >=10 event groups, >=100 censored query rows, >=5 censor groups, >=10 later event cells, >=5 later event groups, all from fit cohort.
limits: Grid uses training groups only; future support is counted only through day 400.
The 15 development validation groups were previously inspected, so future use is not independent confirmation.
Selected cutoff is a design condition, not a demonstrated model gain.
